text:
prakṛter mahāṃs tato ’haṃ-kāras tasmād gaṇaś ca ṣoḍaśakaḥ
tasmād api ṣoḍaśakāt pañcabhyaḥ pañca bhūtāni.

adhyavasāyo buddhir dharmo jñānaṃ vi-rāga aiśvaryam
sāttvikam etad-rūpaṃ tāmasam asmād viparyastam.

abhimāno ’haṃ-kāras tasmād dvi-vidhaḥ pravartate sargaḥ
ekādaśakaś ca gaṇas tan-mātraḥ pañcakaś caiva.

sāttvika ekādaśakaḥ pravartate vaikṛtād ahaṃ-kārāt
bhūtādes tan-mātraḥ sa tāmasas taijasād ubhayaṃ.

ubhayātmakam atra manaḥ saṃkalpakam indriyaṃ ca sā-dharmyāt
guṇa-pariṇāma-viśeṣān nānātvam bāhya-bhedāc ca.

śabdādiṣu pañcānām ālocana-mātram iṣyate vṛttiḥ
vacanādāna-viharaṇotsargānandāś ca pañcānām.

svā-lakṣaṇyaṃ vṛttis trayasya sā eṣā bhavaty a-sāmānyā
sāmānya-karaṇa-vṛttiḥ prāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañca.

yugapac catuṣṭayasya tu vṛttiḥ kramaśaś ca tasya nirdiṣṭā
dṛṣṭe tathā ’py a-dṛṣṭe trayasya tat-pūrvikā vṛttiḥ.

svāṃ svām pratipadyante paras-parākūta-hetukāṃ vṛttim
puruṣārtha eva hetur na kena cit kāryate karaṇam.

karaṇaṃ trayodaśa-vidhaṃ tad āharaṇa-dhāraṇa-prakāśa-karam
kāryaṃ ca tasya daśadhā hāryaṃ, dhāryam prakāśyaṃ ca.

antaḥ-karaṇaṃ tri-vidhaṃ daśadhā bāhyaṃ trayasya viṣayākhyam
sāmprata-kālam bāhyaṃ tri-kālam ābhy-antaraṃ karaṇam.

buddhīndriyāṇi teṣām pañca viśeṣāviśeṣa-viṣayāṇi
vāg bhavati śabda-viṣayā śeṣāṇi tu pañca-viṣayāṇi.

sāntaḥ-karaṇā buddhiḥ sarvaṃ viṣayam avagāhate yasmāt
tasmāt tri-vidhaṃ karaṇaṃ dvāri dvārāṇi śeṣāṇi.

ete pradīpa-kalpāḥ paras-para-vi-lakṣaṇā guṇa-viśeṣāḥ
kṛtsnam puruṣasyā’rtham prakāśya buddhau prayacchanti.

sarvam pratyupabhogaṃ yasmāt puruṣasya sādhayati buddhiḥ
sā eva ca viśinaṣṭi punaḥ pradhāna-puruṣāntaraṃ sūkṣmam.
